# About This Edition {.unnumbered}

This Compilation mostly mirrors that of the Partial Inventory as of October 2026. This was translated using GPT 5.4 and Claude Sonnet, unless there is a prior translation done by the leadership of the Baha'i Faith. 

This compilation will evolve in 2 ways. The 1st is to transform the English towards a more contemporary and modern English. This will be done with both AI tools and any collaboration with other translators. To support this, a dictionary and lexicon will be made available that can be consulted on. Translations can evolve as the consultative process evolves. The other way will be in the organization of the volumes themselves. Currently they are ordered by chronology. There are numerous ways these can be organized, and the current vision is to focus on the 3 major stages of revelation (Bayani period, Announcement period, and the Kitab-i-Aqdas period). These books and volumes will be published under the Crimson Ark Media umbrella with a public copyright, to maximize availability. 

While attribution is important, all translation work will only have Baha'u'llah as the author, and Crimson Ark Media as the compiling and publishing authority. While the work of individuals is paramount to this effort, this work is done in humble service to God and in honor of Baha'u'llah. Only His Greatest Name should appear on His Word.

Each writing is identified by its BH reference number. As translations evolve, their most recent translation date and mode will be provided.
